SYMPTOM: Keyboard doesn't appear on first try; blank white flash or no keyboard visible until second switch
CAUSE: `showGlobe` property setter in KeyboardView called `rebuildLayout()` — full teardown and reconstruction of all key rows. This fired on every `viewDidAppear` when the 0.3s deferred block set `keyboardView.showGlobe = needsInputModeSwitchKey`, triggering a complete layout rebuild at appear time.
FIX: 
1. Add `private var globeButton: UIButton?` stored reference to KeyboardView
2. In `makeBottomRow`: always create the globe button (don't skip it), store reference, set `isHidden = !showGlobe`
3. Change `showGlobe` setter: `didSet { globeButton?.isHidden = !showGlobe }` — no rebuildLayout call
4. Clear reference in rebuildLayout: `globeButton = nil`
FILE: WhisnapKeyboard/KeyboardView.swift
PREVENT: Never call rebuildLayout() from a property setter that's set at appear time
